title: Permissions request / reply
description: Shape of the success-path data field returned by `cos perms check`. Apps call this via SDK helpers (e.g. cos_runtime.policy.check).

decision.description: Whether the call would be permitted right now.

scope.description: Scope object: shape depends on the verb (path/host/name/wild). Present when supplied by caller.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the decision.

hint.description: If denied, what the user should do (e.g. "open Settings → Permissions and grant fs.read").
